_comment: Hand-curated, verifiable metrics. Every number here must be traceable to a committed artifact in the linked repo. Update by hand; languages and contributions are pulled live by scripts/hero.py.

kpi.label: macro-F1
kpi.source: ml-hackathon-bacteria/STRATEGY.md — ExtraTrees300, 3-fold CV on 90k rows; baseline DecisionTree(max_depth=5) = 0.641 LB

kpi.label: cohen's d
kpi.source: spot-the-bot-maltese/results/clustering/bootstrap_significance.json — noise fraction, B=40 bootstrap over independent 30k subsamples, Mann-Whitney p=2.93e-12. Strongest of the four significant metrics; n_clusters d=1.40, Davies-Bouldin d=1.25, Calinski-Harabasz d=1.19, silhouette not significant (p=0.081)

kpi.label: lstm params
kpi.source: spot-the-bot-maltese — word-level LSTM, 2 layers, hidden 512, embedding 300, 50k vocabulary; 8 epochs on the Maltese corpus
